record.field: Create a knowledge page (document.page) for the team from text you supply. Use when the user asks you to document something so that colleagues can read it. Returns the new page's id, title and history id. Required: title. Optional: content (HTML), category (parent category name — created if missing), summary (one line describing the change). The page is team knowledge: it always passes the approval gate, and you must never document on your own initiative — propose and ask first.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"title": {"type": "string", "description": "Page title (required). Short, specific and findable."}, "content": {"type": "string", "description": "Page body as HTML. Plain paragraphs are fine."}, "category": {"type": "string", "description": "Parent category name. Created if it does not exist."}, "summary": {"type": "string", "description": "One line describing what this page establishes."}}, "required": ["title"]}

Create a knowledge page (document.page) for the team that documents an existing Odoo record. Use when a record's content is worth documenting for colleagues. Required: model (technical name) and res_id. Optional: title (defaults to the record's display name), content (your HTML summary; defaults to a short generated summary), category, summary. The model must be one you are allowed to read — a model outside your scope is denied. The page is team knowledge and always passes the approval gate.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"model": {"type": "string", "description": "Odoo model technical name, e.g. project.task (required)."}, "res_id": {"type": "integer", "description": "Id of the record to document (required)."}, "title": {"type": "string", "description": "Page title. Defaults to the model name plus the record display name."}, "content": {"type": "string", "description": "HTML summary of the record. Defaults to a short generated summary."}, "category": {"type": "string", "description": "Parent category name. Created if it does not exist."}, "summary": {"type": "string", "description": "One line describing what this page establishes."}}, "required": ["model", "res_id"]}

Create a knowledge page (document.page) for the team that documents the current conversation. Use when a conclusion reached in dialogue is worth documenting for colleagues. You supply the title and the HTML content — you already hold the conversation in context, so write it yourself. Required: title and content. Optional: category, summary. Fails with an actionable error when content is empty (nothing to document). The page is team knowledge and always passes the approval gate.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"title": {"type": "string", "description": "Page title (required). Short and specific."}, "content": {"type": "string", "description": "HTML body documenting the conversation (required)."}, "category": {"type": "string", "description": "Parent category name. Created if it does not exist."}, "summary": {"type": "string", "description": "One line describing what this page establishes."}}, "required": ["title", "content"]}
